dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a smooth concave curvature (falcate) from the apex down to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded geometry with a small radius at the terminal morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin shows a moderately steep convex slope relative to the longitudinal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base pixel width is approximately 1.5 times the vertical height of the fin from base to apex.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: The melon presents a distinct convex arc terminating at the rostral crease.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Elongated and slender rostral projection with a high length-to-thickness ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: A sharp obtuse angle is visible at the pixel junction where the melon slope meets the rostrum.
